# AI Free for Boomers

> Free, plain-English AI lessons for people who didn't grow up with a cell phone, and for the small-business owners who serve them. No jargon, no credit card, no scare tactics — just what to type and why.

Run by Joshua (founder) and Fernando (co-founder). The whole approach: if you're confused, we explained it badly — not your fault.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://aifreeforboomers.com/): hero pitch, live demo of questions AI can answer, a 3-question quiz that points visitors to a starting place, and answers to the most common trust questions (privacy, scams, whether it's "listening").
- [About](https://aifreeforboomers.com/about): who runs this and why it's free.
- [Resources](https://aifreeforboomers.com/resources): index of the articles below.
- [1-on-1 Help](https://aifreeforboomers.com/consulting): private paid sessions, no slides, no jargon.
- [Cheat sheet](https://aifreeforboomers.com/cheat-sheet): a printable one-pager, "5 Things You Can Ask AI Today."

## The three questions people actually ask

- **Is it listening to me?** No. It only sees what you type, when you type it. It isn't sitting in the room with you, and it can't turn on your microphone.
- **Will it steal my information?** Never type passwords, Social Security numbers, or bank details — yours or a customer's. Everything else is fair game.
- **How do I spot a scam?** Anyone who rushes you, demands secrecy, or asks for gift cards is a scam — AI or not.
